limitations: Candidate county vote totals use only reporting_units candidates[].votes.total. NYT model estimates, expected vote, and calls were not substituted for vote counts.
When source units are township or municipality records, each unit is included once and summed into a county using fips_state + fips_county.
No blanket license is asserted; factual counts are attributed to The New York Times. AP is credited only when the race outcome records called_by including ap.

preferred_verified_source.provider: Reported election returns via The New York Times
preferred_verified_source.message: 105 counties with published returns. Source times apply to the published race feed; individual local update times are not supplied. Unofficial counts; no forecast or expected-vote estimates are included.
